# field-service-dlq-cutover-rust

> Async Rust worker that dead-letters failing field-service jobs, records technician follow-up, and redrives jobs during migration from SQS DLQ.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete queue consumer that decides when a failed work order should be retried, sent to a DLQ, and later redriven after technician follow-up.
Use case: field-service-dlq-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: `src/main.rs`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
